items.title: Police make arrest in a deadly shooting at Winston-Salem State during homecoming weekend
items.brief: Authorities on Sunday arrested a man in a shooting during homecoming weekend at a historically Black university in North Carolina that left one person dead and at least one other person injured.

items.title: Bicycle ‘boycott ride’ targeting Jewish-owned businesses in Philadelphia draws hundreds of counterprotesters
